description: Header file defining the TargetPublicPair class and TargetPublicPairListBuilder for managing ordered, unique lists of target dependencies with public/private flags in build systems.

classes.name: TargetPublicPair
classes.description: Encapsulates a pair of a target pointer and a boolean indicating if it is public, with utility structs for hashing and comparison.

classes.name: TargetPublicPairListBuilder
classes.description: Builds a unique, ordered list of TargetPublicPair instances, supporting appending direct and inherited dependencies.

methods.name: TargetPublicPair
methods.description: Default constructor and parameterized constructors for TargetPublicPair.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Adds a target with its public/private flag to the list, updating existing entries if necessary.

methods.name: AppendInherited
methods.description: Appends dependencies from another container, adjusting public/private flags accordingly.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Returns the final list of TargetPublicPair instances.
